## Key pages
- [Research]({{ site.url }}/research/): the lab's research directions, each with a figure from the lab's own papers. The same page in Korean, in the lab's own words: [Research in Korean]({{ site.url }}/research/ko/).
- [Publications]({{ site.url }}/publications/): {{ site.data.publications | size }} papers; each has a detail page at {{ site.url }}/publications/<id>/ with its citation, and its abstract and DOI where it has them.
- [Members]({{ site.url }}/members/) and [Alumni]({{ site.url }}/alumni/): lab people, each with a page at {{ site.url }}/people/<slug>/.
- [Principal Investigator]({{ site.url }}/pi/): {{ site.data.pi.name }}.
- [News]({{ site.url }}/news/): lab updates and milestones.
- [Positions]({{ site.url }}/positions/): how to join the lab and how to apply (postdoctoral researcher, graduate student, and undergraduate research), including currently advertised undergraduate projects. Written in Korean.

## Selected recent publications

Each entry links its page on this site, in the llms.txt list form "[name](url): notes"; brackets in a title (e.g. [4+2]) are escaped so the link stays intact.{% endcomment -%}
